/**
   * Deletes the folder with the given ID from the server.
   *
   * @param listener - Listener to indicate the success or failure of the
   *   folder deletion operation.
   * @param folderId - The ID of the folder to delete.
   */
  void deleteFolder(in IExchangeSimpleOperationListener listener, in AUTF8String folderId);

  /**
   * Empties the folder with the given ID from the server (deletes all
   * messages and subfolders).
   *
   * @param listener - Listener to indicate the success or failure of the empty
   *   folder operation. The `ids` argument of `onOperationSuccess` is currently
   *   unset, the `useLegacyFallback` argument is true iff EmptyFolder was
   *   unsupported and the workaround was used (which hopefully shouldn't
   *   matter).
   * @param folderId - The ID of the folder to empty.
   * @param subfolderIds - The IDs of the child folders of the given
   *   folderIds. Only used if EmptyFolder operation is not supported.
   * @param messageIds - The IDs of the messages in the folders listed in
   *   folderIds. Only used if EmptyFolder operation is not supported.
   */
  void emptyFolder(in IExchangeSimpleOperationListener listener, in AUTF8String folderId, in Array<AUTF8String> subfolderIds, in Array<AUTF8String> messageIds);
